canonical_question: What specific characteristics of the Turbula 2F device ensure uniform mixing of high-density elemental powders?

question_variants.question: What specific characteristics of the Turbula 2F device ensure uniform mixing of high-density elemental powders?
question_variants.resolution_summary: The document states the Turbula 2F device was used for mixing for 10 hours at 45 rpm, but it does not explain the specific characteristics of the device that ensure uniform mixing of high-density powders.

answers.answer: The text confirms the use of the Turbula 2F device for 10 hours at 45 rpm to mix elemental powders, but does not describe the mechanical characteristics of the device that ensure uniform mixing.
answers.boundary_limitation: No description of device mechanics provided.
evidence_spans: Several methods of powder metallurgy were used to prepare the equimolar HfNbTaTiZr HEA.
Elemental powders (purity >99%) and granularity of −325 mesh (<44 μm) were supplied by Huarui Co. (Chengdu, China).
Weighting and mixing of powders was performed under Ar protective atmosphere.
